msg: The purple gnomes give the most mushrooms upto 9. as do the pinkish purple ones. After selecting them a number of times the return in mushrooms decreases when it reaches 3 select one of the other coloured gnomes to see if they are any better. Rule of thumb 3 or less try a different coloured gnome, but the two purply ones give the best results. Rember to keep tapping the space bar after selecting the gnome so you don't get timed out picking in the forest.
